interfaces.signature: ERPAStateGraph.run(message: str, thread_id: str='demo-thread', user_id: str='planner-01', *, bypass_cache: bool=False) -> dict[str, Any]
interfaces.semantics: Caller supplies message and optional identity. Initializes store; hit returns answer/data/trace with empty recall and write instrumentation; miss assembles, decides, dispatches and persists.
interfaces.preconditions: Cache bypass flag; hit saves trace, not ordinary memory. Lookup defaults identity; caller must not assume isolation.
interfaces.postconditions: Caller supplies message and optional identity. Initializes store; hit returns answer/data/trace with empty recall and write instrumentation; miss assembles, decides, dispatches and persists.
interfaces.errorHandling: Invalid provider and store failures not fully enumerated; no tested latency.
interfaces.variability: Offline and live graph are separate; use synthetic query with explicit thread and user, avoid assuming caller identity is authenticated.
interfaces.quality: No independently measured latency, throughput or concurrency SLA
interfaces.rationale: Typed or named boundary supports local inspection; exact caller authentication must be established separately
interfaces.usage: Offline and live graph are separate; use synthetic query with explicit thread and user, avoid assuming caller identity is authenticated.

interfaces.signature: BoundarySemanticCache.get(question: str, user_id: str=settings.user_id) -> dict[str, Any] | None
interfaces.semantics: Returns cached envelope or None; disabled or excluded query returns None. Live scopes prompt by tenant and user; namespace includes model, thinking, answer contract and data version.
interfaces.preconditions: The offline graph calls get(message) without its run user; inspect local lookup default namespace. No claim of verified tenant isolation.
interfaces.postconditions: Returns cached envelope or None; disabled or excluded query returns None. Live scopes prompt by tenant and user; namespace includes model, thinking, answer contract and data version.
interfaces.errorHandling: Threshold 0.82 and exclusion heuristic; no measured hit rate.
interfaces.variability: Pass correct principal, bypass for mutations; compare equivalent questions with different principals.
interfaces.quality: No independently measured latency, throughput or concurrency SLA
interfaces.rationale: Typed or named boundary supports local inspection; exact caller authentication must be established separately
interfaces.usage: Pass correct principal, bypass for mutations; compare equivalent questions with different principals.

interfaces.signature: BoundarySemanticCache.put(question: str, answer: str, payload: dict, tokens: int, user_id: str=settings.user_id) -> None
interfaces.semantics: Stores eligible answer with scoped namespace; local INSERT OR REPLACE and live semantic cache update.
interfaces.preconditions: Writes cache only if enabled and cacheable. Payload and token count persist.
interfaces.postconditions: Stores eligible answer with scoped namespace; local INSERT OR REPLACE and live semantic cache update.
interfaces.errorHandling: Store errors and stale policy effects untested.
interfaces.variability: Use matching lookup identity, not mutation requests.
interfaces.quality: No independently measured latency, throughput or concurrency SLA
interfaces.rationale: Typed or named boundary supports local inspection; exact caller authentication must be established separately
interfaces.usage: Use matching lookup identity, not mutation requests.

interfaces.signature: recall(query: str, user_id: str='planner-01', limit: int=8, *, thread_id: str='demo-thread') -> list[dict[str, Any]]
interfaces.semantics: Retrieves memory records for query and user/thread; return bound by configured provider behavior.
interfaces.preconditions: Read operation; identity defaults require explicit review.
interfaces.postconditions: Retrieves memory records for query and user/thread; return bound by configured provider behavior.
interfaces.errorHandling: Local/live retrieval differences; recall quality not measured.
interfaces.variability: Supply same principal and thread as request; do not share personal records.
interfaces.quality: No independently measured latency, throughput or concurrency SLA
interfaces.rationale: Typed or named boundary supports local inspection; exact caller authentication must be established separately
interfaces.usage: Supply same principal and thread as request; do not share personal records.
